timeConvention.sampling: Sample each clip at clamp(t - startSeconds, 0, durationSeconds). Hold endpoints when outside the clip. Camera moves each start at local 0.

coordinates.matrixRule: M_three = C * M_blender * inverse(C). Cameras look along their local -Z.

fx.rootSpace: World translation already in GLB. Do not add origin again.

lights.name: FX_LUZ_SOL_LUNAR
lights.note: Calibrar intensidad y sombras en el renderer. Es un valor de referencia de Blender.

lights.name: FX_LUZ_REBOTE_SUAVE
lights.note: Calibrar intensidad y sombras en el renderer. Es un valor de referencia de Blender.

lights.name: FX_LUZ_CALIDA_TOBERA
lights.note: Calibrar intensidad y sombras en el renderer. Es un valor de referencia de Blender.

runtime.intensityBeforeFirstOff: Interpolate by frame, apply emissiveIntensity per node and use the warm preview power curve to drive the scaled PointLight intensity.
runtime.dustOpacity: Static embedded RGBA. Use keyed scale and optionally cull collapsed cards.
runtime.sky: Use exposed star meshes with depth testing against the terrain; scene.background is supplied by the app.

mixers.cameras: AnimationMixer on the camera GLB scene. Use selected shot local time.
mixers.lander: AnimationMixer on the LANDER GLB scene; play only LANDER_DESCENT.
mixers.effects: After reparenting FX_TOBERA_ANCLA, bind the FX clips with an AnimationMixer on a common ancestor of the FX and LANDER scenes. Start all FX clips once and sample at scene time.
evaluationOrder: sample LANDER and FX to the scene time
mixers.visibility: Disable the plume at frame >= 178. Dust can be culled per card when scale is zero.
